import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Convert the 'Sex of respondent, 1979' column to a categorical variable
df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] = df['Sex of respondent, 1979'].astype('category')

# Create a boxplot to visualize the relationship between gender and highest grade completed
sns.boxplot(x='Sex of respondent, 1979', y='Highest grade completed, 1979', data=df)
plt.title('Relationship between Gender and Highest Grade Completed')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Highest Grade Completed')
plt.show()

from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Separate the data by gender
male_grades = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 1]['Highest grade completed, 1979']
female_grades = df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 2]['Highest grade completed, 1979']

# Perform an independent samples t-test
t_statistic, p_value = ttest_ind(male_grades, female_grades, nan_policy='omit')
t_statistic, p_value
